blockers: CRITICAL THREAD SAFETY VIOLATION: Removed in-flight frame tracking without replacement in onFrame() (qttunebridge.cpp:148-167). The old code had m_inFlightFrames atomic counter with MaxInFlightFrames=1000 to bound the queued backlog. The new code checks m_currentFrameCount >= MaxFrames BEFORE queuing, but this does NOT bound the queued backlog - frames can still queue faster than processing, leading to unbounded queue growth and potential memory exhaustion. The comment in old code 'Backpressure: bound the QUEUED backlog, not the lifetime count' is now violated.

CRITICAL THREAD SAFETY VIOLATION: MaxInFlightFrames constant removed from qttunebridge.h:148-149 (diff shows removal). This constant was essential for bounding queued frames across the worker/GUI thread boundary. Without it, there is no backpressure on QMetaObject::invokeMethod queued calls.

CRITICAL FUNCTIONAL REGRESSION: Complete removal of signal decoding in handleFrameInternal() (qttunebridge.cpp:183-203 diff shows removal). All signal-related code (staging buffer, signal set iteration, qttune_decode_signal calls) was removed. This breaks the core LiveView functionality that was being phased in.
questions: What is the intended backpressure strategy now that in-flight frame tracking was removed? The current check on m_currentFrameCount before queuing is insufficient.
Why was the SignalBatchesAreCoalesced test removed? This test verified timing contracts for signal updates. Was this functionality moved elsewhere?
Why was StreamingContinuesPastTenThousandFrames test removed? This test specifically validated thread-safe frame processing past the 10k boundary.
Is there a replacement mechanism for the signalModel property that was removed from QtTuneBridge? The LiveView QML page was also removed entirely.
nits: Buffer size assumption in removed code: qttune_decode_signal was called with hardcoded 8 bytes, but qttune_frame_t.data is 64 bytes for CAN-FD support (not a blocker since code was removed, but worth noting).
Formatting inconsistency in qttunebridge.cpp:238 - extra space before comment on 'QSortFilterProxyModel' declaration.
